notes:
This page is written as prose with the numbered bullets landing on the ASIDES rather than on the instructions -- every real instruction here is an unnumbered sentence and every [n] is the note or the route hanging off it. Read as a player: bullets 1-3 are three national quest CHAINS of four quests each, of which you complete exactly one ('no mix and matching allowed'); bullet 4 is a note about which maws count; bullet 5 is a route; bullet 7 is travel advice. So source_bullets point at the nearest numbered sibling and each note says which prose line the step actually is.

The three chains are a prerequisite, not steps, and they are an OR over twelve titles. gates.prev is an AND-list, so putting them there would gate this quest on all twelve forever -- it stays empty and the chains are recorded here instead: San d'Oria (S) Knights of The Iron Ram > Steamed Rams > Gifts of the Griffon > Claws of the Griffon; Bastok (S) Republican Legion's Fourth Divison > The Fighting Fourth > Better Part of Valor > Fires of Discontent; Windurst (S) The Cobras > Snake on the Plains > The Tigress Stirs > The Tigress Strikes. The header's own Previous field is empty, so nothing is lost that the header claimed.

Start is moved off the header. 'Clients: Cait Sith, Kupofried' are the cutscene pair, not standing entities -- what you click in Pashhow Marshlands (S) is the Veridical Conflux at (J-9), which resolves and can carry a marker. The header's zone is kept and its string is in start.raw.

The last step deliberately carries no marker: 'Voidwatch Officer' is one of the names the resolver refuses without a zone (it would otherwise mark every Voidwatch Officer in the game), and the page names no zone -- only 'one of the three starting-Nations (past or present)'. Better an honest empty rung than a marker in the wrong city. Its [KI] Voidwatch alarum is also the header's Reward, so it is not used as evidence either; the only evidence in the quest is Kupofried's medallion at Xarcabard (S).

the unnumbered line above bullet 7; bullet 7 itself is just travel advice (Recall-Pashh, or the nearby Survival Guide). The conflux is by the Pashhow Gate Crystal. Cutscene only -- nothing is handed over here.

the unnumbered line after bullet 7: speak to a Voidwatch Officer in one of the three starting nations, past or present, for the [KI] Voidwatch alarum. The page shouts that this cannot be done at Jeuno or at any other outer-city Voidwatch Officer. Target is left as none because 'Voidwatch Officer' is a name shared world-wide and the page gives no zone to narrow it -- naming it here would either mark every officer in Vana'diel or demote the whole quest. The alarum is the header's Reward, so it is not evidence.

notes:
Four bullets, of which bullet 2 is a whole journey and splits into three rungs: the Picture frame that opens the Den of Rancor, the trip down to the Cloister of Tides, and nothing else -- the rest of that bullet is routing (in at Yhoator Jungle (J-12), out at (F-5) on Map A, back in along the left wall, (I-7) on Map B, drop the hole at (J-7) on Map C, in at (I-7) on Map D) and lives in notes.

The protocrystal step is NOT in the walkthrough at all; the header Description is what says 'Ring the tuning fork of water upon the protocrystal in the Den of Rancor', and Notes bullet 2 confirms every party member needs their own fork. So the fork requirement is put on a trade to the Protocrystal, which is the entity you actually ring it on, rather than being left hanging on the fight. That name comes from the page's own Description, not from me.

items_partial on the Picture frame is real: the Unity warp to Den of Rancor (content level 128 or under) skips both the frame and the [KI] Paintbrush of souls entirely. The paintbrush itself is picked up somewhere inside the Temple of Uggalepih, and the page never says where, so there is no rung for getting it.

The empty [TABLE] at the top is prepass residue. The whole 'After the walkthrough: Notes' section is party size, the 30-minute limit, one reward at a time, a once-per-Earth-day repeat, the Mini Fork of Wtr. shortcut from Trial-Size Trial by Water, and a hint to keep the whisper for The Moonlit Path -- none of it is a step, and none of it is observable.

ADVERSARY (stage D): downgraded to medium and the walkthrough_in_table flag dropped. The flag was false -- the page's only table is the empty two-pipe residue at the head of the walkthrough, and not one rung of this quest lives in a table. Medium because the page is incomplete in two places by its own admission: it never says where inside the Temple of Uggalepih the [KI] Paintbrush of souls comes from ('be sure to get it'), and it never states the ring-the-fork-on-the-protocrystal action at all -- step 4 is recovered from the header Description and from 'enter the Protocrystal normally' in After-notes bullet 6, not from the walkthrough. The ladder itself was attacked rung by rung and stands: both key items are granted at the rung that carries them, the Tuning fork of water is evidence on step 1 and only a held item on step 4, the Whisper of tides is evidence on step 5 and only a held item on step 6, no item is evidence twice, and neither appears in the header's Reward list. The two (I-7) grids in bullet 2 are correctly separated -- Temple of Uggalepih Map B keeps its grid, the Den of Rancor Map D one is not carried onto the Cloister rung. Nothing added.

notes:
The cleanest page in this batch and the longest evidence chain: four key items across four zones, all of them granted at the step that grants them and none repeated.

The job gate is real but narrow -- bullet 1 says 'while on Rune Fencer' and bullet 8 says the cutscene and fight can be done as any job -- so jobs is ['RUN'] and the note on step 1 carries the rest. The header's Level field is empty, so no level is invented even though this is relic-tier artifact armour.

Bullets 7 and 8 are one step: the same Bloodstained Glove, examined twice, exactly like the Blank Target in Divine Might -- once for the cutscene, once more (after every party member has seen it) to pop Insidio. Bullet 9's third examine is the page's own '(Optional)' and stays a separate optional rung because it comes after the kill. The long solo strategy sub-bullet under 8, and the Bayld consolation for helpers, are advice.

The Marjami Ravine target is a bare ???, which can never carry a marker; it keeps its rung, its zone and its (I-8) anyway. Note that 'Use Ignis three times' is a Rune Fencer rune, not an item and not a trade -- nothing there to model. The Yahse wildflower petal and Insidio's extinguished lantern are both KEY items despite the page not tagging them [KI]; the resolver confirms it, and neither appears in the header's Reward (Runeist Coat), so both are honest evidence.

at the base of the waterfall east of Bivouac #2. Use the rune Ignis three times, then interact with it. If nothing happens, go back to Gaddiux and repeat until he sends you for the petal first and Marjami second. A bare ??? cannot carry a marker; the rung and the zone are kept regardless.
the Adoulinian Kelp option again, for another cutscene.

the secret beach south of Bivouac #2; the glove is on the shoreline. Examine it once for the cutscene, then -- only after every party member has watched it -- examine it again to spawn Insidio. Any job from here on, and Trusts are allowed.

an Orobon NM. Mayhem Lantern is an AoE Charm and every use cuts the physical damage it takes, until almost none lands. Only party members actually on the quest get the lantern; helpers get up to 10,000 Bayld once.

the page marks this '(Optional)'; he is at the proto-waypoint and asks for the Runic kinegraver in exchange for an extra cutscene. It happens after the reward, so it is not part of the ladder proper. No grid is given.

notes:
Bullet 5 is the trap on this page: it names Arciela, Ygnas and Darrcuiln, and none of them is the target. They are who you meet; what you interact with is the Alpine Trail at (H-5), and that is what takes you into Mount Kamihr. A verb-scanner would have written talk/Arciela here.

Bullet 6 has no fixed place. You go to the Crag closest to your HOME nation -- not your current allegiance -- and the page names only one of the three (Crag of Holla, and only inside an example about the Treasures of the Earth crystals). The Crags are not zones in their own right either, so there is nothing to record: the Ergon Locus row is left zone-less on purpose, which makes it match the Ergon Locus wherever the player actually is. Its two sub-bullets are real conditions and both are invisible to the addon: mid-way through Dances with Luopans without a [KI] Luopan you must convert this soil and come back for a second, and you cannot get it at all while holding the matching Treasures of the Earth crystal.

Bullets 8 and 9 are the same Drifting Feather twice -- once for the cutscene, once to enter the battlefield -- so they are one rung. Bullet 10 is the reward cutscene on the win, not a hand-in; there is no NPC to return to and none is invented. Bullet 11 is a 'See also' link.

Quest Reqs are two whole mission lines (all of Seekers of Adoulin including Arciela's Trust, and the final chapter of Rhapsodies of Vana'diel). The header's Previous names the two capstone quests and those go in prev; the mission completion itself has no slot in the schema and nothing observable to test, so it is flagged rather than faked.

ADVERSARY (stage D): downgraded to medium. The ladder survived every attack -- bullet 5's Alpine Trail really is the thing you interact with and Arciela, Ygnas and Darrcuiln really are bystanders the sentence merely names; the two Drifting Feather examines really are one rung; bullet 10 really is the outcome of the win and not a hand-in, so no NPC was invented for it; bullet 11 really is a 'See also'; both key items are granted at the rung that carries them, neither is evidence twice, and neither is in the header's Reward list. But the quest cannot stand at 'high' while two entire mission lines (the Seekers of Adoulin missions including Arciela's Trust, and the final chapter of Rhapsodies of Vana'diel) are gates with no slot in the schema, and while step 6 carries no zone at all because the Crag varies with the player's home nation. That is the guide's own definition of medium -- 'the ladder is right but a gate is unmodellable' -- and it is what the corpus already does for every other quest flagged with an unmodelled mission gate. Nothing added or removed.

notes:
Both of this quest's tables are OR-lists, not AND-lists, and they are modelled two different ways because the schema only has one honest tool for each.

The twenty base weapons are one per job, so exactly one of them applies to you. That is items_alt with an empty items -- the runtime reads alt as 'any single one of these', which is precisely right, and the same shape already exists in the index for Melyon and Exoroche. All twenty resolve. Holding any of them is also the ONLY observable thing in this quest, so it is step 1's evidence (evidence.alt, empty evidence.all -- legal, and the shape already used for the Mandragora quest). The weapon comes back augmented at the end, but it is deliberately not put on the last step as well: duplicate evidence would jump the mark straight to the end.

The nine Watchful Pixie locations are a different problem -- you need ONE of them, but a group is the only way to draw more than one place at a time, so they share group 'pixie' and every note says only one is needed. This is a compromise and it is flagged: unordered_group here means 'any of these', not 'all of these'. The alternative was one zone-less Watchful Pixie row, which would have thrown away nine good zones and grids.

Each location's own NM set is carried on its own step. Vunkerl Inlet (S) has an empty grid in the source table, so it gets none. The Meriphataud Mountains (S) row is malformed in the wiki table -- 'Yii Haqi the Threnodist Nuu Gazo the Dirgerimer Slate Scorpion x2 Ochre Scorpion x2' with no separators -- and is split the only way it reads.

The header's grid is missing; (F-6) comes from bullet 2 and is used for both start and the trade. Bullet 5 and everything under it is a discussion of what augments are possible, admittedly under-documented -- the page carries Category:Information Needed -- and is not a step. The five re-rolls at the Jubilant Pixie are a count nothing reports.
